Karansul

Biography

Karansul dominates trade in the city of Ingos and owns mines, sawmills and workshops. Sver describes a system of debt, low purchase prices and intimidation. When Zak obtains leverage over his hidden accounts, Karansul supplies information about Flein the Baldie and arranges a meeting. His suggestion to fetch a gold nugget from an abandoned pit conceals a dangerous trap for the inquisitive newcomer. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]
